generalized weakness and easy fatiguability since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of Presenting illness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 5\u0026nbsp; years back then she started to have desire to eat non edible material and went to the hospital and was diagnosed with Anemia (Hb 4gm\/dl) and 2 units of PRBC transfusion was done\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENow since 2 months she is complaining of easy fatiguability with generalized weakness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o SOB(grade ll-III) insidious in onset, gradually progressive to grade III,c\/o exertional dyspnea\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo c\/o chest pain, palpitations, orthopnea,pnd\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo c\/o fever,loose stools, vomitings\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o similar complaints in the past\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o two PRBC transfusion\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/k\/c\/o diabetes HTN TB Asthma Epilepsy thyroid disorders\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet\u0026nbsp; Mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder\u0026nbsp; regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions No\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDaily routine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt wakes up around 7 am takes breakfast and goes for coaching institute and comes back at 6 am and takes dinner at 8 pm and sleeps around 10 pm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHer daily routine did not changed even after the illness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral Examination\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt is conscious coherent and cooperative\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo Icterus, cyanosis, clubbing generalized lymphadenopathy,edema\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVitals\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETemp afebrile\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBp 110\/80 mm Hg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPR 92 bpm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERR\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESystemic
